note: Hand-curated decode of the non-action BLE command handlers (D0/D1/D2/F0) and the HID device-name binding. Offsets are payload offsets (image base 0). Confidence labels: Confirmed (from disassembly), Correlated (matched to app/protocol behavior).
first_payload_byte: lbu a4, 0(s0)  (s0 = received BLE frame body pointer)

handlers.summary: Enable/select a per-connection notification stream. Requires first payload byte == 1, then calls the connection-slot status setter 0xb7c6 with selector a1=3.
evidence: 0xc060: lbu a4,0(s0); c.li a5,1; bne a4,a5 -> 0xbcba (reject unless byte==1)
guarded by a resident-region flag at lbu (gp-0x...) before falling through to 0xd2 path

handlers.summary: Disable/teardown the notification stream selected by D0. Requires first payload byte == 1, then calls 0xb7c6 with selector a1=4, and returns via the unknown/no-reply tail 0xbcba.

Raw register/diagnostic read. Invokes resident vtable slot 0x40000048 (a2=8,a1=0, out-buffer sp+0x14) to fetch 8 bytes, byte-swaps pairs into big-endian halfwords, then publishes them via the shared raw-frame store 0x28e (a0=1,a1=4).
evidence: 0xc08c: c.li a2,8; c.li a1,0; addi4spn a0,sp,0x14; c.jalr a5 (a5 = lw 0x48(0x40000000))
0xc09e..0xc0ba: lbu/slli/or assembling big-endian 16-bit words from the fetched bytes

handlers.summary: Configuration/provisioning write. Rejects sub-code s3 <= 0xD (bgeu guard), validates a 14-byte credential/name via 0x12d4 (byte-compare against an expected 14-byte buffer), and on success forwards (s3-0xE) entries starting at frame+0xE to the config worker 0xa39a.
evidence: 0xc0f8: jal 0x12d4 with a1=0xe (14-byte compare/validate); bnez a0 -> reject

helpers.0x12d4: 14-byte buffer validate: builds expected buffer via 0x129c, compares frame bytes 0..13; returns 0 on match.
helpers.0xa39a: config worker: stores a 16-bit handle, then dispatches on (payload[0]-1) through a 7-entry jump table (range-checked bltu 6) into config-RAM writers.

hid_name_binding.summary: On GAP discovery/connect the firmware compares the peer device name against a fixed list of keyboard identities to pick which HID profile to emulate / which peer to bind. Each comparison loads a resident compare function pointer, passes the candidate name string and its length, and branches on a 0 result.
evidence: 0x99ca: auipc/addi a0 -> 0x11604 ('BT KeyBoard'); c.li a2,0xb; jalr resident cmp
0x9a50: a0 -> 0x11620 ('MINI_KEYBOARD'); c.li a2,0xd; jalr resident cmp
0x9a68: a0 -> 0x11630 ('BLE-M3'); c.li a2,6; jalr resident cmp
0x9a5c: lui s6,0x40; lw a5,0x3c(s6) reloads the resident compare pointer
